confirmed.text: 项目目标：PC 本地运行的实时语音 Companion，角色为派蒙。核心体验是低延迟、自然轮次、可打断、适度主动插话，不是一问一答式语音助手。
第一阶段范围限制：不做 3D/X4 Air/直播平台/手机 App/视觉理解/长期记忆/自训练 ASR、TTS、LLM。
技术方向：Python + Pipecat 作为实时语音 pipeline 底盘；轮次检测用 Silero VAD + Pipecat Smart Turn。
ASR/LLM/TTS 全部通过 Provider 抽象接入，业务层不直接 import 供应商 SDK；LLM 第一版用 OpenAI-compatible adapter。
TTS 第一阶段赛马候选：Fish Audio、MiniMax、ElevenLabs；CosyVoice 为后续自部署候选。选型标准为低 TTFA、中文自然度、情绪表现、可 streaming、易取消。
ASR 第一阶段使用低延迟云端 Streaming ASR API；FunASR/SenseVoice/Whisper 类方案后续再评估。
项目核心资产是 Conversation Core：TurnManager、InterruptionManager、InitiativePolicy、ContextManager、Conversation State Machine、Persona/Behavior Policy、Latency Metrics。模型可换，这部分必须自己写。
对话状态机最小集合：IDLE / LISTENING / POSSIBLE_END / THINKING / SPEAKING / INTERRUPTED / SILENCED。
上下文管理区分 Logical History（模型生成了什么）与 Heard History（用户实际听到了什么），被打断时不能混写。
LLM 输出结构化结果（speech/emotion/energy/should_continue），为未来 TTS 情绪、表情、3D 动作扩展预留接口。
第一版开发使用耳机，暂时规避 AEC/回声消除问题；产品化后再考虑 WebRTC AEC。
第一版 UI 为 Terminal，无需 GUI；MVP 目标 SEFA 500–800ms 区间、连续运行 ≥10 分钟、可替换 ≥2 个 LLM 与 ≥2 个 TTS Provider、有基础 latency log。
主动性策略第一版用可解释评分规则，硬规则优先：用户说话中或 SILENCED 状态下 NEVER_SPEAK；第一版默认不真正打断正在讲话的用户。
项目文档 00–07（README/scope/architecture/conversation core/tech stack/persona/MVP/decisions）已存在，是 loom 初始事实来源。
远程仓库：GitHub 私有仓库 Haaaiawd/paimon-voice-poc，本地 main 分支已跟踪 origin/main。
LLM 第一轮赛马名单：DeepSeek + 通义千问（DashScope），均走 OpenAI-compatible 接口。
ASR 第一轮锁定阿里云百炼/通义听悟流式语音识别（DashScope 平台）。
TTS 第一轮只用 Fish Audio；若实测体验不达标再补赛马。
开发环境：Windows 原生 Python 3.12（语音闭环在 Windows 跑，不在 WSL）；Docker 用于依赖打包。
DashScope key 尚未到位，用户在申请中；ASR 集成任务在此之前保持 blocked。
Smart Turn v3.2 官方 benchmark 中文准确率 85.79%、FNR 9.26%（23 语言倒数第三）；约 9% 轮次会落入 3s 静音兜底，metrics 需记录每次 complete 的来源以区分模型短板与接线错误。
reference/ 目录以 git submodule（--depth 1）挂载 pipecat/smart-turn/silero-vad/fish-speech/funasr/cosyvoice/livekit 共 7 个开源项目，只作只读参考，不作依赖 import。
TASK-003/007/008 依赖 API key：DeepSeek 或 DashScope 任一（benchmark）、DashScope（ASR）、Fish Audio（TTS）；key 写入 .env 后可执行验收。
Fish Audio 免费层实测：模型串 s2.1-pro-free 可用（200 OK），免费期至 2026-11-30，Fair Use 无硬字符上限；付费模型（s1/s2-pro）在当前账户返回 402（API credit 与平台 credit 分账）。
s2.1-pro-free 从本机（中国大陆）HTTP 实测 TTFA：冷启动 ~3-4s，热身后 ~0.9s；无 SLA/延迟保证，且服务端声明请求数据可能用于模型改进。跨境网络是主要变量，常驻 WebSocket（/v1/tts/live）可省去每轮握手，真实管线内 TTFA 待 TASK-008 实测。
FISH_API_KEY 已在 .env 就位（fish_audio_api_key=sk-fish-***），TASK-008 的 key 阻塞解除。
备选：阿里云百炼 cosyvoice-v3.5-flash / qwen-audio-3.0-tts-flash 支持 WebSocket 双向流式（continue-task 增量文本 + finish-task 收尾），后者支持指令控制情绪；与 paraformer ASR、通义 LLM 同平台同 key，新用户有免费额度。

百炼 key 已就位并实测（sk-8ee3...，账户余额 ~5 元）。直连下：qwen-flash LLM TTFT 233–448ms；paraformer-realtime-v2 ASR 握手正常（task-started→finished 无鉴权错误）；qwen-audio-3.0-tts-flash 首音 516–745ms；cosyvoice-v3-flash 可用（longanhuan_v3 796ms / longhuhu_v3 热身后 626ms，含每次新建 WS 握手）。

cosyvoice-v3-flash 音色 longanhuan_v3（欢脱元气女）/ longhuhu_v3（天真烂漫女童，6-10 岁）契合派蒙人设；Instruct 文本指令控制情感（neutral/fearful/angry/sad/surprised/happy/disgusted + 闲聊互动场景 + 傲娇公主角色），直接对应 emotion 标签映射。cosyvoice-v3.5-flash 在本账号引擎报错 418 不可用。
本机存在代理 127.0.0.1:55483（WSL 环境变量注入 + Windows 系统层），给每次 TLS 连接加 ~1.9s：经代理 LLM TTFT 2.6s vs 直连 233ms。语音链路必须绕过代理直连 dashscope.aliyuncs.com / api.fish.audio，.env.example 已记录。
百炼三层链路自闭环验证通过（2026-09-21）：cosyvoice-v3-flash TTS 生成中文语音 PCM(16k) → paraformer-realtime-v2 ASR 流式识别回原文，逐字正确（仅标点归一化），partial/final 事件流与词级时间戳正常；qwen-flash LLM TTFT 233–448ms。
Windows 控制台 GBK 编码会把 UTF-8 中文显示为乱码——测试脚本需 PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 或 stdout.reconfigure；Terminal UI 实现时同理。

assumptions.text: 仓库将托管到 GitHub 私有仓库用于云端同步（待确认平台与可见性）。
.loom/ 目录纳入 git 版本控制，使项目状态随仓库同步。
Fish Audio 与 DeepSeek 的 API key 将由用户提供并放入 .env（未确认是否已有）。
Fish s2.1-pro-free 在 WS 常驻连接下的热 TTFA 可能显著低于 HTTP 实测值；若管线实测仍 >300ms 则触发切换到百炼 CosyVoice（赛马回退路径）。

attempts.summary: Handoff chain is largely intact: intent is clear (PC Paimon voice companion, SEFA 500-800ms target range), all 11 deliverables are nominally covered by 12 acyclic tasks, first task TASK-001 is concretely executable, and capability hooks map to real decision-tree nodes whose API names were verified against the vendored pipecat checkout. However I found 8 real (all minor, none blocking the first task) inconsistencies: an acceptance/boundary contradiction in TASK-003, normative docs stale relative to decisions D-009/D-010/D-011 (including wrong decision-ID citations in tech-stack.md and an MVP §8 clause that only survives via a reconciliation note in a design doc TASK-012 does not read), the key speculation mechanism (turn-taking#C6) referenced by no task, missing dependency edges for audio I/O and end-to-end SILENCED verification, an unspecified SILENCE_REQUESTED producer, missing Chinese-accuracy caveat for Smart Turn, an implicit Pipecat-vs-custom-Core ownership boundary, and deliverable drift in DLV-009.
evidence: .loom/PROJECT.md:7 SEFA 500-800ms target declared as range not hard commitment; line 46 says D-001-D-010 while DECISIONS.md contains D-001-D-011
.loom/tasks.json TASK-003 (lines 126-135): criterion demands both-vendor table vs boundary allowing DeepSeek-missing; F-020 in state.json records DashScope key still pending
.loom/tasks.json TASK-007/008 verify_by require live mic/speaker demos but depends_on=[TASK-002] only; TASK-011 acceptance mentions 端到端 verification but depends_on=[TASK-005,TASK-009]
.loom/design/tech-stack.md lines 23,25,43: decision IDs D-009/D-008/D-010 cited where DECISIONS.md shows the correct IDs are D-010/D-009/D-011
06_MVP_AND_EVALUATION.md §8 line 263 '可替换至少 2 个 TTS Provider' vs DECISIONS.md D-009 single Fish Audio; reconciliation note exists only at .loom/design/mvp-evaluation.md:41, absent from TASK-012 reads
07_DECISIONS_AND_OPEN_QUESTIONS.md lines 100-114: '尚未决定' 1-3 remain open in the normative doc though resolved by D-009/D-010 and F-016/F-017

turn-taking/capability.md C6 defines partial-driven speculation; no task capability_hooks references it (hooks used: turn-taking C1/C2/C4/C5, low-latency C1/C5, chinese-tts-eval C1-C4, streaming-asr-zh C1-C3)

verified against reference/pipecat checkout: LocalSmartTurnAnalyzerV3 (local_smart_turn_v3.py), TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy, SmartTurnParams(stop_secs=3.0, pre_speech_ms=500, max_duration_secs=8) all exist; v3.2 model bundled in package, CPU onnxruntime, no download needed; smart-turn README confirms 23 languages including Chinese; HF benchmark smart-turn-v3.2-cpu shows Chinese accuracy 85.79% FNR 9.26%
dependency graph verified acyclic: TASK-001 is the unique zero-dependency task and is concretely executable (write pyproject.toml/.env.example/Dockerfile, run pip install + docker build)

loom check: healthy=true, 0 errors; warnings only for the 4 provisional dossiers and 11 not-yet-done deliverables; blocked=0 though F-020 says ASR task stays blocked (key-blocked state modeled only as boundary text in TASK-007/008)
git status: .gitmodules + 4 reference submodules staged but uncommitted; reference/cosyvoice untracked — frozen-for-keeper tree differs from committed tree

gaps.gap: TASK-003 acceptance contradicts its own boundary and has no modeled key precondition: criterion requires a table with BOTH DeepSeek and DashScope data (>=20 runs each), while the boundary permits running only Tongyi when the DeepSeek key is missing; additionally F-020 records the DashScope key as still pending, so with zero keys the task is entirely unrunnable and its acceptance is literally unreachable under the declared contingency.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: A fresh Agent executing TASK-003 with one or zero keys cannot tell whether the task is done or blocked; it must guess whether the boundary relaxes the criterion, and a TASK-012-blocked chain inherits the ambiguity.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Acceptance rewritten to 'each configured provider runs >=20 times, at least one provider required, missing-key providers marked N/A in output', or an explicit key precondition is declared;TASK-003 criterion and boundary no longer contradict.

gaps.gap: Normative docs drifted from recorded decisions: root 06 §8 still requires '可替换至少 2 个 TTS Provider' (superseded by D-009 single-Fish; the interface-level reconciliation note lives only in .loom/design/mvp-evaluation.md which TASK-012 does not read); root 07 '尚未决定' items 1-3 are already resolved by D-009/D-010/F-016/F-017 but remain listed open; root 04 §6/§7 still say ASR unlocked / TTS two-vendor race; .loom/design/tech-stack.md cites wrong decision IDs throughout (ASR cites D-009, should be D-010; TTS cites D-008, should be D-009; Docker cites D-010, should be D-011); PROJECT.md says decisions are D-001-D-010 while D-011 exists. Housekeeping echoes: assumption A-001 still active though F-015 confirmed the repo; Q-006 marked resolved with empty resolution.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: At TASK-012 an agent reading root 06 §8 literally will record '≥2 TTS providers' as a failed MVP line or must independently rediscover the interface-level interpretation; wrong decision-ID citations mislead anyone tracing rationale.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Root 06 §8 / 07 / 04 updated or annotated to reflect D-009/D-010; tech-stack.md decision IDs corrected; PROJECT.md decision range corrected; TASK-012 reads include .loom/design/mvp-evaluation.md (or 06 §8 itself amended); A-001 resolved, Q-006 resolution filled.

gaps.gap: The speculation handshake that makes the latency budget reachable — ASR partial drives prompt pre-construction and LLM submission fires on turn_complete OR final (turn-taking#C6, asr-turn-interplay 'partial 驱动准备、final 驱动提交') — is referenced by no task's capability_hooks and covered by no acceptance criterion; no task owns which transcript text is submitted to the LLM at turn-confirm time.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: An implementer defaulting to 'wait for ASR_FINAL before calling LLM' combined with max_sentence_silence=500ms inflates the ASR stage to ~600ms+ versus the 50-150ms budget, silently breaking SEFA — exactly the 'capability tree bypassed and nobody noticed' failure mode PROJECT.md §Completion warns about.
gaps.evidence_to_close: TASK-005 or TASK-010 gains a turn-taking#C6 hook and an acceptance assertion (e.g. recorded-event test asserting turn_complete submits the latest partial transcript without waiting for ASR_FINAL), or the design docs explicitly delegate submission timing with the reason.

gaps.gap: Missing dependency edges: TASK-007 and TASK-008 verify_by demos need real microphone capture / speaker playback, which TASK-004 builds (src/turn, src/runtime), yet both depend only on TASK-002; TASK-011's second criterion requires end-to-end SILENCED verification but depends_on lacks TASK-010 (the pipeline assembly it would run on). PROJECT.md's stated order (010 → 011) is not encoded in depends_on.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: An Agent selecting by depends_on may take TASK-007/008 before TASK-004 and be forced to write throwaway audio I/O duplicating the real layer, or attempt TASK-011's end-to-end criterion with no pipeline.
gaps.evidence_to_close: depends_on edges added (007/008 → 004, 011 → 010) or boundaries explicitly state the demo supplies its own minimal audio I/O / that integration-test scope suffices for TASK-011.

gaps.gap: SILENCED lifecycle producer unspecified: the SILENCE_REQUESTED event (doc 03 §4) has no declared producer — no doc or task says who detects '闭嘴两分钟' (keyword rule vs LLM intent) or who detects the wake condition '喊派蒙' inside SILENCED, while TASK-011 acceptance requires both behaviors.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: The TASK-011 implementer must invent an undesigned NLU/rule mechanism; different agents would produce incomparable implementations of a user-facing safety behavior.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Doc 03 or TASK-011 names the producer and minimal mechanism (e.g. ASR_FINAL text rule-matching for silence request and wake phrase), with tunables noted.

gaps.gap: turn-taking dossier claims '模型判定是自然度上限' but does not record smart-turn-v3.2's official Chinese benchmark (accuracy 85.79%, FNR 9.26% — third-worst of 23 languages): ~9% of complete turns will fall into the stop_secs=3.0 fallback and dominate SEFA p95; C3's tuning expectation is unanchored to this fact.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: During TASK-004 manual verification or TASK-012 eval, occasional ~3s dead air will be indistinguishable from wiring bugs; the Agent cannot tell model shortfall from misconfiguration.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Research file or C3 records the Chinese accuracy/FNR numbers and the contingency (shorter stop_secs, FilterIncomplete supplement, or accepted p95 hit).

gaps.gap: The boundary between Pipecat's native machinery and the self-built Conversation Core is implicit: Pipecat ships user-turn start/stop strategies, InterruptionFrame broadcast, and context aggregators, while the project builds TurnManager/InterruptionManager/dual-history — no doc or task states whether native interruption is reused as trigger or disabled, or whether aggregators are bypassed, so double interruption paths or double context writes are decidable only by guesswork at TASK-010 integration time.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: At integration, an Agent must guess the intended architecture; a wrong guess yields duplicate interruption handling or Pipecat aggregator context diverging from the designed heard/logical history.
gaps.evidence_to_close: 02_SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md or conversation-core design doc adds a mapping: which Pipecat primitives are reused as signal sources (VAD, turn strategies, InterruptionFrame) vs which are owned by Core (state machine, interruption six-step, context history).

gaps.gap: DLV-009 drift: deliverable title still promises 'LLM TTFT benchmark + TTS 对比测试' but post-D-009 no task delivers TTS comparison; TASK-003's chinese-tts-eval#C4 hook must_produce 'TTFT/TTFA/结构化成功率实测表' imports TTFA into a pure LLM benchmark — a misfired hook.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: Deliverable coverage is nominally complete while half of DLV-009's promise has no owner; the hook's must_produce misleads TASK-003's acceptance scope.
gaps.evidence_to_close: DLV-009 title narrowed to the LLM benchmark (or a Fish test-sentence-set task added to own TTS evaluation), and TASK-003's hook wording corrected.

review.evidence: Host spawned an independent subagent with no access to the shaping conversation. Review was conducted solely from files on disk (.loom/*, root 00-07 docs, reference/pipecat source checkout) plus `loom context --keeper`, `loom check`, and one external web check of smart-turn-v3 language support. No shaping-context assumptions were used.
